MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable feels useful alongside my TV and DVD player because it could serve a familiar connection need, and the extra length would give me flexibility in placing them.",
    "A spare charging cord fits my pattern of buying practical accessories for devices I already use. I would consider this one if its connector fits my Fire 7, especially for its longer reach."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The outdoor Ethernet cable and WiFi adapter address networking needs I have not expressed. Buying cables and adapters does not mean I currently need to install outdoor wiring or fix wireless connectivity.",
    "My GPS accessories do not establish a need for an RV camera, and my tablet case does not establish a need for a laptop sleeve. Those products depend on equipment or uses that my history does not show.",
    "The DIRECTV remote, optical cable, HDMI-to-VGA cable and Bluetooth receiver each require a particular setup or problem. Their broad connection to electronics is not enough for me to choose them now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repeated cable and adapter purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any connection accessory, although each purchase served a specific device and purpose.",
    "My TV, tablet and GPS purchases seem to have been stretched into interest in additional home entertainment, laptop and vehicle equipment without a clear link to what I use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Exact compatibility matters to me: a charging cord must fit my Fire 7, and an audio or display cable must match the ports I actually need to connect.",
    "My history includes several closely related purchases, such as the Fire 7, memory card and case bought together. Accessories that complete a known setup feel more relevant than products that introduce a new one.",
    "My latest purchase was a camera lens cap, alongside a longer history of tripods and memory cards. Practical camera accessories would feel more grounded in my interests than an RV camera system."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in useful device accessories, but often treated a broad electronics connection as enough without establishing compatibility or a current need."
}
